source.reference: HoneyBook web app, Projects screen and pipeline header (help.honeybook.com article screenshots, 2026)
source.method: Pixel samples taken with PIL from the 3136x1792 Projects screenshot; sizes measured at 1x (1024 px wide render).

measured.shadows: none on cards; one soft shadow on the dropdown overlay

font.ui: Figtree 400/500/600/700 (free geometric sans closest to Proxima Nova)

tokens.icons: Phosphor, regular weight (bold for the active nav item), 16 to 18px
tokens.motion: Record sheet slides 24px in 160ms. Nothing else animates.

layout.nav: Dark left rail 232px: logo mark and name, 4 work views with live counts, a rule, House rules, signed-in user at the bottom. No group caps labels.
layout.pageHeader: Search pill top left on the canvas. Title 28px left, at most one primary button right, underlined view tabs under the title.
layout.tables: One white panel with an 8px radius and a 1px line. Sentence-case header on white, rows 56px, rules between rows, sort carets, pagination footer 'Showing 1–10 of N'. Row click opens the record sheet.
layout.record: Right sheet 560px, title 20px bold, definition list, date check, draft, activity, sticky action bar with the primary button on the right.
layout.status: One neutral pill style (sunken background, body text) with a small dot. Colour only means urgency.
